gloss: table card; face-up card on the playing field

definitions.gloss: table card; face-up card on the playing field
definitions.explanation: A card that has been played and is lying face-up on the table in a card game. Used in hanafuda, karuta, and other traditional Japanese card games, as well as modern card games.

examples.japanese: {場札|ばふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{手札|てふだ}→手札：18171_tefuda⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Check the table cards before playing a card from your hand.

examples.japanese: {場札|ばふだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧⟦{札|ふだ}→札：23002_fuda⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手元|てもと}→手元：07605_temoto⟧にない。
examples.english: I don't have a card in my hand that matches any of the table cards.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花札|はなふだ}→花札：22650_hanafuda⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{場札|ばふだ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{札|ふだ}→札：23002_fuda⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手札|てふだ}→手札：18171_tefuda⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: In hanafuda, if you play a card from your hand that matches the month of a table card, you can take both.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧ (place, field) and ⟦{札|ふだ}→札：23002_fuda⟧ (card, tag). A card game term referring to cards that are in play on the table, as opposed to ⟦{手札|てふだ}→手札：18171_tefuda⟧ (cards in one's hand) or ⟦{山札|やまふだ}→山札：19911_yamafuda⟧ (draw pile). Most commonly associated with ⟦{花札|はなふだ}→花札：22650_hanafuda⟧ (hanafuda) and ⟦かるた→かるた：21979_karuta⟧ (karuta) but also used in other card games.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {場札|ばふだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧: to match a table card
- {場札|ばふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take a table card
- {場札|ばふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧: to lay out the table cards

- ⟦{山札|やまふだ}→山札：19911_yamafuda⟧: draw pile / stock pile
